actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create a fresh COMPLETE exterior-parts artboard for the one specified fictional anime dagger. Input1 is the current five-piece layout; retain its blade, separate guard, separate red collar and separate pommel. Input2 is the accepted full dagger master, controlling the TRUE exterior grip shape. The only material correction is to the separated GRIP, which input1 has mistakenly given extra flared cap material from adjacent parts.

Keep exactly FIVE detached exterior pieces in the same spaced layout: blade left; guard upper-middle; collar upper-right; grip lower-middle; pommel lower-right. All have white gaps, no assembly drawing or complete joined dagger. The master blade, guard, red collar, grip and pommel remain distinct. No hidden tang, fasteners, rod, hole, internal machinery, manufacture instructions or dimensional annotations. Pure visual component artwork for a fictional character.

The corrected grip must end at the MASTER'S existing top/bottom color seams. It must contain NO fragments of the guard, red collar, pommel or end cap. Its endpoints may be clean blunt/straight exterior terminations with a slight NATURAL INWARD TAPER, but NEVER protruding external rims, outward mushroom caps, wide cup mouths or extra rings. Do not hide the error by coloring a cap black; eliminate the extra silhouette entirely. Preserve the intended central grip shape and visual decoration.

Keep all remaining shapes/color/materials from input1 unchanged, including the blade's angular shoulders and the independently complete pommel. Displayed pieces may be enlarged for viewing; this is not a common-scale dimension sheet. The accepted full-master nominal sizes are unchanged. White background, same complete canvas, clean Japanese handdrawn/cel color planes, no white specks/noise/patina. Only a clean dark-blue SANS-SERIF heading as specified. Fresh whole-tool drawing, not local cut-and-paste.
IVORY dagger only. Correct the curved black-and-ivory grip: REMOVE BOTH the outward-flared bottom ring and the wide top cup-shaped lip. At both ends the black grip outline narrows naturally like the master, ending without any extra collar or flange. Carry the single ivory winding stripe continuously to those simple ends. The separate IVORY teardrop pommel lower-right already contains the complete pommel and orange oval; none of its upper rim is attached to the grip. Keep the separate crescent guard and red collar intact. Preserve the blade's deliberately angled inner shoulder near the tip. Heading IVORY.
